claim_ceiling: Constrained hierarchical Leiden (min_cluster_size + adaptive sub_resolution) on 174k TF-IDF embeddings produces a valid multi-resolution hierarchy with perfect nesting (1.0 by construction), zero fragmentation (singleton_fraction < 0.1%), and measurable zoom refinement (branch purity delta +0.03 to +0.09, area purity delta +0.03 to +0.13, improvement_rate 57-90%). This method is CPU-feasible and production-ready for TF-IDF modes at full 174k scale. Flat independent Leiden at multiple resolutions is NOT a valid fractal map method at 174k scale (fails v26 frozen rule). Dense embeddings remain blocked at 174k (only 3/26 years complete).
evidence_summary: Verified: (1) v26_verdict.json — flat clustering FAIL at 174k (0/4 modes pass, >99% singletons at res_3.0, nesting 0.44-0.90); (2) constrained_hierarchical_174k_full/hybrid05/hybrid07/regeste.json — 4/4 TF-IDF modes PASS hierarchical test (nesting=1.0, singleton_fraction<0.1%, branch_delta +0.03 to +0.09, improvement_rate 57-90%); (3) constrained_hierarchical_dense_2000_2015_coarse0.15/0.2.json — 99k dense PASS v26 with coarse_res optimization (improvement_rate 55.6-58.8%, zero fragmentation); (4) constrained_hierarchical_citing_alpha0.3/following_alpha0.3.json — citation roles PASS at 1k (improvement_rate=100%, zero fragmentation); (5) constrained_hierarchical_debiased_citation_blended_1k_coarse0.15/0.2/0.3.json — eval-validated representation PASS (improvement_rate 66-75%); (6) constrained_hierarchical_dense_3yr_results.json — 12.5k dense structural PASS (nesting=1.0, branch_delta +0.07 to +0.14) but FAILS v26 flat rule with 14-41% fragmentation; (7) product_integration/ and product_integration_174k/ — all 4 TF-IDF modes fully artifact-integrated at 174k. Nesting metric defect v1 confirmed and properly scoped. No leakage, gaming, or overclaiming detected.
